title: TabDDPM: Modelling Tabular Data with Diffusion Models
summary: This is the official research code for the paper "TabDDPM: Modelling Tabular Data with Diffusion Models," implementing a denoising-diffusion generative model for tabular data and comparing it against several baseline generators (SMOTE, CTAB-GAN, CTAB-GAN-Plus). The CTGAN package (mirrored from sdv-dev/CTGAN) is vendored in-tree, and its TVAESynthesizer is imported and run as one of the baseline models evaluated against TabDDPM.
evidence: CTGAN/train_sample_tvae.py:5-41 imports and instantiates TVAESynthesizer from the vendored CTGAN/CTGAN package as a baseline
needs: README gives no named authors/affiliations; CTGAN copy is used (not just bundled), but only as a comparison baseline
